runtime.dedup: visitorKey all-time by default; uniqueWindowSeconds can limit UV dedup to a time window
runtime.rankLimit: public rank clamps request limit by maxRankRows
runtime.accessIntegration: public view status/record/rank require readable content when content.access is enabled
runtime.adminListLimit: admin counter/daily/log lists clamp request limit by maxAdminListRows
runtime.adminStats: view.stats returns content count, aggregate view count, unique view count and log diagnostics for admin dashboards
runtime.adminStatsUi: ability page renders view.stats as a metric table
